derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r823 localized persistent context activation and before extracting or scoring r824 features. This is the first direct real-domain local-risk supervision test: each LOSO teacher sees only provisional marker boxes from training parent sources. Held-out source boxes are never read for teacher targets or head inputs. No synthetic images, threshold search, backbone tuning, or lifecycle change.

teacher.target: max continuous exp(-distance/1.5_patches) over all provisional marker bboxes; all-zero on no-detection frames
teacher.input: frozen Depth Anything V2 Small DINO-S layer 11 at 224
teacher.split: fit separately inside each complete parent-source LOSO training fold
teacher.weights: equal near/far mass, equal source mass within near/far, equal frame mass within source

event_head.feature: unchanged r819 global and 13-dimensional route-local field statistics
